$ref.description: Path to content that replaces the $ref

equals_number_value.description: The attribute value is exactly this number.  Note that this may not be the desirable behavior when comparing float values.

equals_string_value.description: The attribute value is this string.

name.description:
The attribute that is expected to have a particular value.

Nested attributes are accepted (e.g., `"foo.bar"`).
